errors.text: The proposed severe-plastic-deformation and annealing route does not reconstruct the powder-based high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering route.
The alloy composition is unspecified, so FCC/BCC coexistence, intermetallic suppression, and the annealing stability window cannot be scientifically assessed.
No prior evidence is cited despite the explicit request for support concerning grain-refinement mechanisms and phase-stability limits.
The processing conditions are qualitative and provide no deformation strain, pressure, annealing temperature, duration, or atmosphere.

The falsification experiment does not distinguish grain-boundary strengthening from simple solid-solution strengthening because it lacks samples with matched composition and phase fractions but systematically varied grain size.
